title: Past perfect: guided practice
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.prompt: When I got home, my parents ___ dinner.
items.explanationEs: Cenaron antes de que yo llegara: had + participio (eaten).

items.prompt: When I got to the door, I noticed that I ___ my keys.
items.explanationEs: Las perdí antes de llegar a la puerta: had lost.

items.statement: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.
items.explanationEs: El ladrón escapó antes de que llegara la policía: had escaped.

items.statement: She had already went to bed when I called.
items.explanationEs: Después de had, el participio: had already gone.

answers: Had you ever seen the sea before?
They had been working all day.
items.explanationEs: Pasado perfecto continuo: had + been + verbo con -ing.
